gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-chivo: Loud, gapped-out letters with generous round curves, that is all Electroharmonix. Chivo, a sans-serif, does the quieter work, packing lowercase up toward the caps with daylight showing through every curved opening.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-cossette-t: Cossette Texte reads wide-eyed, its lowercase e open and prominent. Beside Electroharmonix, its n arches match the stems, so a sans-serif paragraph keeps a uniform texture without light and heavy strokes mixing.
